channel.title: Last Fall Back Act — Updates
channel.description: What we're doing and what we're learning as the Last Fall Back Act moves through the 2027 legislative session.

item.title: We already said yes. Congress hasn't delivered. Time to do this ourselves.
item.description: Washington voted yes in 2019. Congress still hasn't delivered. Our Legislature could act on its own, and has tried four times without a floor vote.

item.title: Most of western Canada has stopped changing clocks. Washington hasn't.
item.description: Most of western Canada has stopped changing clocks. Washington voted to in 2019 and still can't. Here's why, and what we can do about it.
